title: Spectral Incidence Bounds over Finite Fields
summary: Let $\Fq$ be a finite field, let $F,G\in\Fq[T]$ be nonconstant, and let $J\in\Fq[T]$. We study the parameterized two-parameter family \[ C_{a,b}=\{(x,t)\in\Fq^2:t=J(x)+aF(x)+bG(x)+λab\}, \qquad (a,b)\in\Fq^2, \] where $λ\in\Fq^\times$, with incidences counted with parameter multiplicity. If $d=°F$, $e=°G$, and $\charac(\Fq)>d+e$, we prove the uniform spectral estimate \[ \left|I(\cP,Ω)-\frac{|\cP||Ω|}{q}\right| \ll_{d,e}q^{5/8}\sqrt{|\cP||Ω|} \] for arbitrary $\cP,Ω\subseteq\Fq^2$.
